description: Demolition of existing outbuilding and erection of detached outbuilding at rear.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out in the attached schedule which forms part of this notice. Location Plan WINC/26/LOC dated 15 April 2026Block Plan WINC/26/BLK dated 15 April 2026Existing Floor Plans WINC/26/01 dated 13 May 2026Existing Elevations WINC/26/02 dated 13 May 2026Proposed Floor Plans WINC/26/03 dated 13 May 2026Proposed Elevations WINC/26/04 dated 13 May 2026Proposed Side Elevations WINC/26/05 dated 13 May 2026Existing & Proposed Roof Plans WINC/26/06 Dated 12 June 2026Existing & Proposed Cross Section WINC/26/07 dated 13 May 2026Environment Agency Flood Risk Summary SuDS Pro Forma.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwellinghouse known as 38 Winchmore Hill Road, London, N14 6PT, and shall not be used, occupied, sold, let or otherwise disposed of as a separate dwelling or independent residential unit.Reason: To ensure that the outbuilding remains ancillary to the host dwelling and does not form a separate residential unit, in the interests of protecting the character of the area, neighbouring amenity and the proper planning of the site.
